busy_message: A task is still running. Quit anyway?

ranges_description: Extract single pages or ranges. E.g.: 1-3, 5, 8-  (8- = to the end)

keyword_name_from_match: Name each file after the matching line
keyword_include_before: Keep the pages before the first match
opt_numbering_tip: Adds 01_, 02_... so the files stay in order
opt_bookmarks_tip: Keeps the original PDF's outline (bookmarks) in every file
opt_compress_tip: Reduces file size without losing quality

exclude_tip: Leave this page out of the generated files (X)
rotate_tip: Rotate this page 90° in the generated files (R)
use_as_start_tip: Sets this page as the start of the selected chapter
use_as_end_tip: Sets this page as the end of the chapter and moves to the next one
empty_open_title: Open a PDF to get started

replace_chapters_message.other: {n} chapters detected. Replace the ones you already entered?

settings_context_menu_done: Done: right-click any PDF to split it with Shinobi.pdf.
tour_1_text: Split, merge and convert your PDFs in seconds. Everything runs on your computer: your files are never uploaded.
tour_2_text: Drop a PDF on the viewer or click “Open”. You can also right-click any PDF in File Explorer.
tour_3_text: By chapters, every N pages, by ranges, by size or by text (great for invoices). The thumbnails show in color which pages go into each file.
tour_4_text: Use “Use as start” and “Use as end” while browsing the PDF, or search text with Ctrl+F. If the PDF has an outline, chapters are detected automatically.
tour_5_text: Merge PDFs, export pages to images or process many files in batch from the sidebar.
update_error_message: Check your internet connection and try again later.

err_unexpected_message:

• Text mode no longer shows an error as soon as you pick it: it only warns when you try to split.
• The destination folder is no longer cut off on screen.
